reading: Along the same-device curve the training set's joint lat x tilt entropy H* moves by at most 0.012 (unique-bin coverage C_joint is identical in every cell) while N runs from 4 to 200, so on these points coverage cannot explain either the rise or the plateau by construction; the N models win the AICc because H* has no variance to explain anything with.

Adding this device's AP and lateral frames LOWERS H* (the epoch concentrates in two bins) and RAISES accuracy; the COBRA arm has a higher H* than the in-domain arm at every matched N and a lower accuracy; the lateral-only arms carry the highest H* of any cell and the worst AP detection, the AP-only arms the lowest H* and the best. At fixed N the sign of corr(acc, H*) is in families B and C.

So in OUR data the plateau is not sampling-density saturation of the acquisition space in the review's sense: the cells that spread the epoch over more of the space do worse on the target protocol than the cells that concentrate on it. The review's mechanism is neither confirmed nor refuted for held-out ANGLES (obliques, the case134 spin), which no cell here trains on; that is the pending matched-N coverage experiment.
